From 45062f441590810772959d8e1f2b24ba57ce1bd9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bob Pearson <rpearsonhpe@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2021 22:59:53 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/rxe: Fix a bug in rxe_fill_ip_info()

Fix a bug in rxe_fill_ip_info() which was attempting to convert from
RDMA_NETWORK_XXX to RXE_NETWORK_XXX. .._IPV6 should have mapped to .._IPV6
not .._IPV4.

Fixes: edebc8407b88 ("RDMA/rxe: Fix small problem in network_type patch")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210421035952.4892-1-rpearson@hpe.com
Suggested-by: Frank Zago <frank.zago@hpe.com>
Signed-off-by: Bob Pearson <rpearson@hpe.com>
Acked-by: Zhu Yanjun <zyjzyj2000@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/sw/rxe/rxe_av.c b/drivers/infiniband/sw/rxe/rxe_av.c
index df0d173d6acb..da2e867a1ed9 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/sw/rxe/rxe_av.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/sw/rxe/rxe_av.c
@@ -88,7 +88,7 @@ void rxe_av_fill_ip_info(struct rxe_av *av, struct rdma_ah_attr *attr)
 		type = RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV4;
 		break;
 	case RDMA_NETWORK_IPV6:
-		type = RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV4;
+		type = RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV6;
 		break;
 	default:
 		/* not reached - checked in rxe_av_chk_attr */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/sw/rxe/rxe_av.c`**
   - A single line of code was modified in the `rxe_av_fill_ip_info` function. The case for `RDMA_NETWORK_IPV6` was changed from assigning `RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV4` to `RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV6`. This corrects the mapping of the network type from RDMA to RXE for IPv6.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug where the IPv6 network type was incorrectly mapped to the IPv4 type. This change ensures that the correct network type is used, thereby fixing the issue identified in the previous patch (edebc8407b88). The fix is part of a broader effort to ensure accurate network type handling in the RDMA/rxe subsystem.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
case RDMA_NETWORK_IPV6:
    type = RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV4;
```
Reason:
The case for `RDMA_NETWORK_IPV6` incorrectly assigns the value for `RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV4` instead of the correct `RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV6`, leading to improper handling of IPv6 network types.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
case RDMA_NETWORK_IPV6:
    type = RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV6;
```
Reason:
This change correctly maps `RDMA_NETWORK_IPV6` to `RXE_NETWORK_TYPE_IPV6`, ensuring that IPv6 network types are handled properly in the RDMA/rxe subsystem.
